title: Life in the Kimberleys
creator_credit: Rhys Bedford, ACMI Digital Storytelling and ACMI
brief_description: Rhys Bedford has a lot of doors open to him, now that he is the recipient of a scholarship at Hale College in Western Australia. But it is when he returns to his family in Kununurra that Bedford gets to explore and reconnect with his country and heritage.
